expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and a black horizontal bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: In the bottom navigation bar, a dark horizontal pill/bar (likely a selected-tab indicator or home-indicator overlay) is drawn across the middle of the bar, overlapping the search icon and the bookmark/orders icon instead of being positioned beneath the active tab or at the screen's bottom edge.

Bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders/bookmark, profile) have no text labels, relying on iconography alone, which can hurt discoverability and screen-reader clarity if labels are missing entirely.

The notification bell button in the top-right shows a red dot badge, but the bell icon itself is low-contrast dark-on-light gray circle; combined with the subtle badge it may be missed, and the badge has no count.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 identifies the same bottom navigation area and the black horizontal bar overlapping the icons, which is the core layout defect.
